slide.name: CMU-1-JP2K-33005.svs
slide.credit: OpenSlide freely distributable test data / Carnegie Mellon University
slide.description: Brightfield; JPEG 2000 export of CMU-1.svs. Source does not document tissue/stain identity.

model.name: TinyUNet (fixed original checkpoint)
model.trained_on: TNBC v1.1 H&E PNG patches; original from-scratch CPU training; no WSI fine-tuning

analysis.scope: Three preselected native 1024x1024 ROIs only; the rest of this WSI is not analyzed.

no_overlap.timing_scope: warm CPU predict(): patch RGB extraction + tissue gate + forward + probability stitch + components + NMS; excludes OpenSlide reading, model load, hashing, PNG/JSON writing and difference selection
no_overlap.memory_scope: fresh process per ROI/method; absolute process high-water RSS including Python/runtime imports, OpenSlide open/read/cache, model load, one warmup and three timed predictions; sampled before result serialization
no_overlap.read_scope: Fresh OpenSlide handle native level-0 read_region + RGB conversion + ndarray copy; OS file cache uncontrolled.
